{{Top|leg}}
'''Faloww''' was a commentator on [[Gundark's Gear Datalog]] during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. Commenting on the entry for the [[RPC-12]] [[restraint capsule]], Faloww detailed a method for overloading the [[Power regulator/Legends|power regulators]] to bring down the [[Force field/Legends|force fields]].<ref name="GFT">''[[Gundark's Fantastic Technology: Personal Gear]]''</ref>
